Moon Active is one of the world's top mobile game companies, our teams leverage cutting-edge technologies to craft fun and interactive games enjoyed by millions worldwide. We produce exciting and engaging entertainment for players across the globe and pride ourselves on developing top-quality casual games that invite and allow players to connect with one another.

Playable Ads are interactive mini-games that are used to engage and attract new users to download and play our games.

As a Game designer you will be in charge of the Game design and polishing the game mechanics and game-flows of our playable ads as well as testing and gaining insights based on how the playable performed.

Responsibilities

- Design levels for top performing playable ads for leading games, to excite, engage, and bring new players to download our games.

- Research and develop innovative game mechanics for playable ads.

- Work closely with game developers and provide constructive feedback on playable ad mechanics and experience.

- Analyze performance data to optimize game mechanics and conversions.

- Collaborate with the game design team with improving our content pipeline and processes.

- Stay current on mobile game advertising trends and best practices.

- Support and collaborate with the team from a level design perspective (Production, QA, Art, Game Design, etc).

Requirements

- Product management role experience in the casual gaming space, or 2+ years of experience designing levels and game mechanics for casual mobile games.

- Strong passion for gaming, particularly with regards to casual mobile games.

- Positive and creative mind with a passion for the level design craft (showcased with a relevant work portfolio).

- Solid grasp of game design methodologies and up-to-date knowledge of the casual audience, casual game markets and player motivations.

- Excellent interpersonal skills to clearly and effectively communicate feedback and design ideas.

- Strong self-driven work ethic and ability to work effectively in an agile team environment.

- Ability to incorporate feedback from your team into your work and use it to learn and grow in your role.

Benefits

Why join Moon Active?

- Be part of a leading global mobile gaming company with a unique product enjoyed by millions.

- Thrive in an exceptional, innovative, and dynamic environment.

- Enjoy full transparency and open communication with talented colleagues across teams.

- Take advantage of tremendous opportunities for professional growth and career advancement within a rapidly expanding company.

- Influence and help build personalized product experiences that impact millions of users worldwide.

We offer

- Generous compensation; paid vacation and sick leave.

- Extensive medical and life insurance coverage for you and your family.

- CrossFit & running classes at the office and MultiSport card.

- Comfortable and modern office located on Królewska 16 street in Warsaw.

- Free daily breakfasts and lunches, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and fruits;

- Latest tech equipment, including macOS devices.

- Training & Development/Tuition reimbursement.

- Friend Referral Program with generous bonuses.

- Fun and collaborative workplace culture with regular Friday Happy Hours and team gatherings.

- Relocation bonus for candidates moving to Warsaw.

- Bicycle and Car parking.

We Play to Win! We Play it Smart! We Play as a Team!

We are committed to investing in our employees and fostering a workplace that champions innovation, creativity, and collaboration. At Moon Active, we empower our team members to unleash their potential and achieve remarkable results every day. We encourage bold decision-making and believe that every individual has a significant impact on our success. Join us and level up your career in a supportive and high-achieving environment!
